entries.zh: 拱手行礼；双手抱拳致敬。
entries.en: reverence made with the hands; to salute with the hands clasped.
entries.notes: R 栏作 hou，与「拱」之对音不合，疑串栏或残漏；H 另有难辨旁注。

entries.zh: 作揖，躬身拱手行礼，深揖为敬。
entries.en: a bow made with the hands clasped; a deep obeisance.
entries.notes: M 栏 tip/tig 二读未定，R 栏空；字义与「reuerencia profunda」相合。

entries.zh: 女子跪拜行礼，以深跪为敬。
entries.en: a woman's reverence, performed kneeling.
entries.notes: H 栏字疑为「跪」（「踝」于行礼义无取），M 之 cue 亦指跪；R 栏存 chim chim，即「深深」。

entries.zh: 钦敬，敬重。
entries.en: to revere, to hold in reverence.

entries.zh: 伏地叩拜，俯身致敬。
entries.en: to prostrate oneself, to bow down to the ground.

entries.zh: 俯伏下拜；「覆」与「伏」同音，疑为同词异写。
entries.en: to bow down low; prob. a homophonous variant writing of 伏 (to prostrate oneself).
entries.notes: 「覆」本义为翻覆，此处与上条「伏」同音 hoj，作行礼义可疑。

entries.zh: 拜倒，俯身下拜行礼。
entries.en: to bow down, to make obeisance.
entries.notes: H 栏右上残字近「去」，M 第三音节 cu 未能确定。

entries.zh: 作揖下拜，深深行礼。
entries.en: to make a deep bow with hands clasped.
entries.notes: M 首音节 gai 与「拜」对音不合，R 栏则作「深深拜」。

entries.zh: 作揖，拱手行礼。
entries.en: to make a bow with the hands clasped (zuoyi).

entries.zh: 作揖行礼；「請」字在此义难定，或为礼节套语。
entries.en: to perform a bow; the sense of 請 here is uncertain, perh. a set phrase of courtesy.
entries.notes: 「作請」非通行语，紧接「作揖」条而列，疑「請」形近致混，未敢定其确义。

entries.zh: 拱手，双手抱拳致礼。
entries.en: to clasp the hands in salute (gongshou).

entries.zh: 举手相请致意，行礼之一种，确切语义未定。
entries.en: a salute made with the raised hands; exact sense uncertain.
entries.notes: 「手請」非通行词，M 词尾另有难辨小记号，L 又仅作 reuerencia，义无从定。

entries.zh: 拱手候立，恭敬等候。
entries.en: to wait upon respectfully with the hands clasped.
entries.notes: L 栏 dependiose pies 连写残损难读，义据 H、M 两栏定。

entries.zh: 叩见，磕头晋见尊长。
entries.en: to kowtow on being admitted to a superior's presence.

entries.zh: 叩拜，磕头行礼。
entries.en: to kowtow, to do obeisance by knocking the head.

entries.zh: 跪落，跪下；女子行礼之姿。
entries.en: to kneel down (a woman's reverence).
entries.notes: H 首字疑为「跪」，M 之 cue lo 即「跪落」。

entries.zh: 深深跪下，女子极郑重之礼。
entries.en: to kneel deeply, a woman's most solemn reverence.
entries.notes: H 栏中间一字残失，据 M 之 chim chim cue 定为「深深跪」。

entries.zh: 跪拜家官，妇人向公婆尊长跪叩行礼。
entries.en: to kneel and bow to one's parents-in-law; a wife's reverence to her husband's elders.
entries.notes: H 首字疑「跪」；M 之 gie cua 即「家官」（公婆），与 L「muger al señor grande」相合。

entries.zh: 深深下拜，隆重行礼。
entries.en: to bow deeply, to make a profound obeisance.
entries.notes: H 栏中间一字残失，据 M 之 chim chim pay 补作「深深拜」。

entries.zh: 参拜，向上位者行礼致敬。
entries.en: to pay one's respects to a superior; ceremonial obeisance.
entries.notes: M 作 cham pay（参拜），H 栏仅录「參」一字，疑漏书「拜」。

entries.zh: 拜请，向神像偶像礼拜祈请。
entries.en: to worship and invoke an idol or deity.
